content:
marta: Deploybot reports release/2024.04 pinned promotion failed during artifact sync to nexus-prod. Blocking promo.
deploybot: [automated] promotion failed for groupId=com.redwood.artifacts artifactId=redwood-core version=2024.04 classifier=wheel -> 409 CONFLICT: remote state mismatch. See logs: https://ci.redwood/5234/logs
devops-sam: Ugh, saw a bunch of transient 412/409s earlier. Looks like the registry GC ran during upload window.
marta: Error excerpt from publish job:
```
ERROR: upload failed: 412 Precondition Failed - upstream manifest changed while attaching blob
TRACE: upload id=abc123 chunk=3/7
```
priya: Can we retry the publish job, or do we need to manually re-sync the staging bucket?
kevin: Retry is fine if it's idempotent, but this looked like a manifest/digest race. If we retry we might produce a new digest and break downstream images.
anna-release: Decision needed: pin to last-good (2024.03) or block the cut and escalate to registry oncall. Change window ends in 2h.
jen-oncall: I'm paged, checking registry ops now. ETA 18m. Could do a manual reconcile of the manifest blobs.
devops-sam: If oncall can reconcile quickly, we can re-run the promotion job and preserve the same artifact version (no rebuild). Otherwise pin to 2024.03 and flag rollback later.
marta: Current test matrix depends on 2024.04 features though — pinning will fail some E2Es. We should avoid pin if possible.
priya: Quick mitigation: mark the promotion as manual and attach the raw wheel from staging (we have the blob in staging s3), then update manifest with the correct digest. That's what we did last year.
kevin: That requires a signed manifest operation; only registry ops can perform it. jen-oncall, can you do manual manifest attach?
jen-oncall: I can, but need approval from release manager. Anna, please confirm.
anna-release: Approve manual manifest attach if it keeps same version artifact and preserves release notes. We prefer to avoid pin.
marta: I'll stop the canary cut and hold the deploybot auto-promo. Please add a note to the release notes: "promotion held due to registry manifest race; manual reconcile performed" if we go ahead.
deploybot: [automated] promotion suspended by user: marta. Promo job id=prom-6789.
jen-oncall: Started manual attach now. Showing 2 orphan blobs to reconcile, applying manifest patch.
devops-sam: Reconcile done. Recommend re-run of promo job with --skip-build to avoid rebuild stamp.
priya: Re-run scheduled by marta. CI trigger: `./scripts/ci/retry-promo --job prom-6789 --skip-build`
marta: Promo re-run succeeded. Deploybot: please resume rollout when you see green.
deploybot: [automated] promotion completed for redwood-core:2024.04 -> promoted to release. Canaries will start on next change window. :tada:
anna-release: Final decision: release window ON but canary rollout delayed 10m for monitoring. Add follow-up action: ops to run postmortem on registry GC timing.
kevin: I'll open a short postmortem PR with timeline and proposed fix (pin registry GC to non-deploy windows).
jen-oncall: Closing oncall task, leaving notes in incident tracker.
marta: Thanks all, updating release notes and closing this thread.
